scope: Base-system power only; native application power optimization excluded; all native hardware, Wi-Fi and SSH retained.

first_boot_verification.mandatory_step: configure_desktop_startup calls raspi-config nonint do_boot_behaviour B4 before enabling APPLaunch
first_boot_verification.missing_lightdm_behavior: B3/B4 return failure if /etc/init.d/lightdm is absent
first_boot_verification.required_change: Verified native provisioning/session contract or separately qualified provisioning alternative.

live_base_observations.cpu_limitation: Includes clients and client-driven service/kernel work; not pure base OS power and not separable by subtracting CPU shares.

options.gate: Full native OOBE/session/device access and hardware acceptance.
Actual residency, cable insertion, recovery/traffic, USB modes and shared hub/input tests.
Physical parent PM, AUX usage, all sensor channels and repeated restore.
Actual controller/rail state, command timing, full repaint/wake/HDMI tests.
Camera/codec physical PM and idle PCM state; do not force standby under clients.

false_wins: Ethernet EEE already enabled; inactive without partner.
No observed heavy swap/writeback or SD writes.
IIO class PM status does not establish parent-device or physical rail state.
No complete-system suspend does not prohibit device runtime PM.

measurement_constraints.power_avg_vs_vi: Unresolved roughly tenfold difference; no correction applied.
measurement_constraints.remaining_charge_slope_limitation: Approximate internal consistency of RemainingCapacity/current, not independent coulomb-counter or physical calibration; sample read skew and smoothing apply.
measurement_constraints.causal_control: Matched common versions/settings/client states in full-source and lean images; stock is compatibility reference.
measurement_constraints.current_device_changes: None apart from normal SSH authentication/audit activity.

pinned_bsp.verification: Fresh agents verified retained archive SHA-256 and inspected the pinned driver files.
